@copilot 仔细评估是否完整实现的任务中要求的所有功能

> @copilot 仔细评估是否完整实现的任务中要求的所有功能

Completed the full implementation across all three files specified in the issue. Here's what was added in commit `de66a2c`:

**`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`** — Named union types following `QuickFilterItem` pattern:
- `ObjectUIConditionalFormattingRule` (field/operator/value)
- `SpecConditionalFormattingRule` (condition/style)
- `ConditionalFormattingRule` union type
- `ListViewSchema`, `NamedListView`, `ObjectGridSchema` all updated to use the union
- Exported from `index.ts`

**`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`** — Zod validator updated with `z.union()` for both formats

**`packages/core/src/ExpressionEvaluator.ts`** — `evaluatePlainCondition()` convenience function that handles both template `${data.x > 1}` and plain `x > 1` expressions with record context

**`packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`** — `evaluateConditionalFormatting` refactored to use `evaluatePlainCondition` and proper union type narrowing

All 494 tests pass across types, core, and plugin-list packages.
